Akasiimuka ha kitabu ekibi leero

The draft is actually correct in Runyoro-Rutooro. Here's a breakdown:

- "Akasiimuka" means "He woke up"
- "ha" is a negative particle
- "kitabu" means "the wrong side"
- "ekibi" means "of the bed"
- "leero" means "today"

So the corrected version remains the same:
Akasiimuka ha kitabu ekibi leero
